scope: Local PostgreSQL 18 UTC, Node 22.23.4, actual components with controlled identities and model. No hosted group mutation or external inference.

regressionsBeforeFix.freshCommandDuringInFlightDraft: A second model dispatch instead of the pending attempt

browser.scope: Actual studio-question and merchant-request components, disposable PostgreSQL, fictional identities and fake model. Not hosted Auth or independent participants.
browser.ordinaryWording: Service-dog and carer questions sent verbatim despite Will/May/Can roster names. Identifying colon-address wording blocked with the matched modal token. Editing cleared the old error and reset sharing consent.
browser.studioExpiry: Expired accepted answer during MERCHANT_REVIEW rendered the stale-request page; no approval control or expired wording.
browser.reload: Actual Chrome reload during a hanging fake draft; new command reused one attempt and one quota unit. Check draft status recovered the original response with sharing unchecked.
browser.draftBusyLabel: Drafting does not claim that a question is being sent.

behavior.modalPrivacy: Common auxiliary grammar, broader noun phrases, embedded clauses, mid-sentence can and question tags; identifying tokens checked separately. Not a general language parser or anonymity guarantee.
behavior.errorBoundary: Only fixed will/may/can tokens may be returned as matchedWord; arbitrary error metadata is excluded.
behavior.staleStudioRequest: Read-only request projection returns STALE if its selected candidate no longer qualifies; approval revalidation remains unchanged and rejects the expired arrangement.
behavior.semanticDeduplication: Same owner, source preference revision, offering and slot reuse an in-flight attempt across command IDs before quota reservation. Actor/user and group locks serialize reservations.
behavior.interruptedAttempts: Older than 45 seconds retire before replay dispatch and before a fresh reservation. Late responses cannot overwrite terminal attempts. Fresh explicit attempts remain quota-limited.

limits: Authored language cases do not prove general English reliability.
Browser checks use local controlled boundaries, not hosted sign-in or independent friends.
No new real model quality or PayPal-provider evaluation was performed.
